comment: professor chapman is very clear about her grading, but the content is a little difficult to understand. There is tons of reading assignments but she provides opportunities to turn every assignment in late.

Professor Chapman was great! It was a bit hard to have a discussion-based class online but Professor Chapman worked hard to make it fun. The workload is manageable and Professor Chapman is a fair grader. As long as you complete all of the assigned work and study for the midterm and final you will do well. Very interesting class!
Loved her! She made class fun and interesting. Make sure to do the readings and journal entries.

Professor Chapman is a decent professor. Her grading criteria is very clear and the class is pretty straightforward. Some of the chapters can be a tad boring but the class overall is fairly interesting. I personally don't like the subject of sociology all that much though, and the class didn't change that.
She is a great professor. There is a lot of reading and long lectures. She cares about those who take her class seriously.

Professor Chapman is an amazing sociology professor who has opened up my eyes to the world of sociology and I cannot wait to declare it as my major in the spring! Professor Chapman is enthusiastic and uses a variety of teaching methods that have been extremely effective for me. She is very accessible, and if you put in the work, you will do great.
Solid choice, very interesting, and uses various methods to teach. There are team assignments, like group tests. Grading is super clear, and as long as you try, its very difficult NOT to get an A.

Dr. Chapman is a great teacher, she is the reason why I decided to minor in sociology. She is hilarious and I love how unique her quizzes are! Her grading criteria is very straightforward. I would definitely take this class again.

She is one of the best professors I have had at Richmond. She is caring and willing to find time to work with you in and outside of class. She is a fair grader and gives useful homework to be able to have good discussions in class
Everyone said it'd be an easy A but its a lot of reading and its all boring. She is a bad teacher and her lectures suck.

Dr. Chapman was my favorite professor this semester. I prefer written responses on tests, so this class was difficult for me due to all of the multiple choice quizzes and tests, but Dr. Chapman is an amazing professor and everything that she assigns is important and interesting (including some really cool documentaries). I highly recommend her.

Professor Chapman made her course, Sport in Society, incredibly enjoyable. It was well connected to issues in the sports world today, and she ran the lectures very well. A decent number of papers, but not too difficult. A possibility of open note quizzes each day, so take good notes. Participation was key to discussion but not a chore. Great prof!

Professor Chapman's class was by far my favorite course of the semester. Not only are the topics interesting, but we always did quirky and fun activities to tie into the lessons. The class is group oriented which I liked since you get to know your members pretty well. I highly recommend people take Professor Chapman. She is a very fair grader too.

Great professor! Her class was by far my favorite to attend this semester. She uses a variety of teaching styles and makes her lectures and assignments interesting. Uses team based learning techniques but they actually work! I learned so much in her class and really enjoyed it. She is understanding and assigns a very reasonable workload.

She is a wonderful professor. All classes are fun and interesting. She has a different approach to teaching, which is pure fun. Has quizzes that do require reading outside of class. 5 papers throughout the semester that should be easy if you genuinely try to do well on them. No final exam.
